game.description: Build and run your own hospital. Expand and furnish departments, manage supplies and staff, research better care and guide patients through diagnosis, treatment and follow-up on the way to three stars.

validation.engineCheck: Eight modules link; final web package passes 120 native headless frames with no warnings.
validation.native: Desktop expansion, furniture relocation, storage construction, supply ordering and flow playthrough passes at molecular; the touch flow passes at cellular. New psychiatry, rehabilitation and storage props render at quantum.
validation.browser: Final desktop and phone operations playthroughs pass without console errors or warnings. Reload checks confirm the retained 7x7 expanded GP office and medicine storage capacity of 56.
validation.saveCompatibility: Version 2.0 and 2.1 hospitals migrate in place. Follow-up care, temporary cover, deliveries and department statistics survive save/load.
validation.longSimulation: Seven-day equipped hospital simulation completes care in every clinical department, automatically replenishes supplies, has no walkouts or deaths, and remains a valid save.
validation.live: Published source modules, file index and manifest match local bytes. Public desktop and phone load in the real browser runtime without console errors or warnings.
